notes: 8/8 mutants on platform/llm/byok.mjs caught; one real defect found by reading and patched with a regression test.

mutants.before: 'openai-compatible': { baseUrl: null, defaultModel: null, keyRequired: false },
mutants.after: 'openai-compatible': { baseUrl: null, defaultModel: null, keyRequired: true },
mutants.line_text: 'openai-compatible': { baseUrl: null, defaultModel: null, keyRequired: false },

mutants.before: if (u.hostname === '0.0.0.0') u.hostname = 'localhost';  // a bind address, not a destination
mutants.after: if (u.hostname !== '0.0.0.0') u.hostname = 'localhost';  // a bind address, not a destination
mutants.line_text: if (u.hostname === '0.0.0.0') u.hostname = 'localhost';  // a bind address, not a destination

mutants.before: if (!cfg || typeof cfg !== 'object') throw new ByokError('no model provider configured');
mutants.after: if (!cfg && typeof cfg !== 'object') throw new ByokError('no model provider configured');
mutants.line_text: if (!cfg || typeof cfg !== 'object') throw new ByokError('no model provider configured');

mutants.before: return { text, usage: { input: (u.input_tokens || 0) + (u.cache_read_input_tokens || 0) + (u.cache_creation_input_tokens || 0), output: u.output_tokens || 0 } };
mutants.after: return { text, usage: { input: (u.input_tokens || 0) + (u.cache_read_input_tokens || 0) + (u.cache_creation_input_tokens || 1), output: u.output_tokens || 0 } };
mutants.line_text: return { text, usage: { input: (u.input_tokens || 0) + (u.cache_read_input_tokens || 0) + (u.cache_creation_input_tokens || 0), output: u.output_tokens || 0 } };

real_defects.issue: isLocal() matched hostnames such as 10.evil.com / 127.attacker.net as private addresses (prefix regex without full-IPv4 anchor), so a page could claim 'nothing leaves your computer' for a remote server

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: estimate: read module, seed mutants, fix and test

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
